common.objection: We already have a scheduling system.
common.response: Acknowledge that existing systems are common, then explore whether staff still spend time on manual follow-up, no-shows, or repetitive front-desk work.

common.objection: We are too busy right now.
common.response: Respect their time, offer a shorter overview, and propose sending a concise recap or booking a later demo.
Explain that pricing depends on workflow scope and location count, and offer to have a specialist scope it after a quick discovery.
